qs.intro_zh: 判断下列每个说法是 True 还是 False，并用 1–2 句话简要说明理由。（每题 3 分）
qs.intro_en: For each of the following statements, indicate whether it is True or False. Provide a brief explanation (1–2 sentences) to justify your answer. (3 points each)
qs.zh: 3.1 抽取式问答方法可能出现幻觉（hallucination）问题。
qs.en: 3.1 Extractive QA methods may suffer from hallucination problem.
scheme: 答案是输入原文的 span，说明与自由生成的区别
qs.explain:
编者按讲义推导；非教师公布答案。
此判断依赖课堂对 hallucination 的狭义用法，不能推广成“抽取式永远事实正确”。若按“无依据或误导答案”的广义定义回答 True，并解释错选原文片段，应结合教师评分口径人工判断。
qs.answer: False under the lecture’s extractive-versus-generative distinction: an extractive QA model returns an answer span from the supplied passage, so it does not invent new answer wording. It can still select an incorrect or misleading span, and the source itself can be false.
